name: external-svg-asset-registry
purpose: Registry for actually collected external open-source SVG assets with source provenance, pinned commits, local license copies, and usage cautions.

reader_guide.summary: Use collected_assets for actual external SVG files stored in this repository. Check source_manifests and local LICENSE files before public redistribution.
how_to_read: Start with collection_summary for counts and source breakdown.
Use collected_assets for local SVG paths and source provenance.
Use source_manifests to find local LICENSE and SOURCE.json files.
Open configs/external-collection-policy.json before changing collection scope.

structure_rules.rule: Each source collection must include a local LICENSE and SOURCE.json file.
structure_rules.reason: Actual external files require local provenance and license traceability.

structure_rules.rule: Collected assets must record the upstream commit used for collection.
structure_rules.reason: Future audits need reproducible source state.

structure_rules.rule: Only SVG files under configured allowed roots may appear in collected_assets.
structure_rules.reason: Official repositories can contain docs, preview images, and non-reusable SVGs.

field_guide.meaning: Source-level collection metadata, license path, commit, and counts.
Actual external SVG files stored in the repository.
Original path inside the upstream repository archive.
Pinned upstream commit used for collection.
Usage caution for the stored external asset.

collection_summary.license_status: Upstream LICENSE files are copied per source. Recheck each source license and attribution before public redistribution.

allowed_svg_roots.path_note: Official Lucide icon SVG source files.

source_manifests.usage_caution: Lucide explicitly separates brand logos; this collection uses icon files only and still requires public-release license review.
Heroicons are stored as source SVG files with upstream license preserved.

allowed_svg_roots.path_note: Official icon SVG files directly under icons/.

source_manifests.usage_caution: Docs and layout partial SVGs are excluded; only official icons/ files are collected.
The first tranche uses outline icons only to avoid filled/outline duplicate inflation.
